name: plan-review-verdict
body: The plan-review agent's verdict on a plan against the change-set delta, in two passes. (a) A DETERMINISTIC coverage verdict: the binary's derived-coverage check (`apg plan verify`, the `domain.entity.plan-coverage` rule) decides which solution nodes' `implemented-by` claims are in scope, and a reported gap is blocking — the agent reproduces the binary's verdict rather than recomputing coverage by inspection. (b) A SEMANTIC verdict on each plan node: whether it does the right thing for the delta, biased toward less code — `deletes` over `modifies`, `modifies` over `creates`, fewer planned nodes — where removing a solution node or an `implemented-by` edge almost always calls for a `deletes` task over the code it pointed at, and any keep/modify instead of that delete must carry a task-note justification.
